spans.s: BP0178 पदार्थः padārthaḥ 1. The meaning of a word or group of words; 2. Substance which exists has a nomenclature and is a subject of Knowledge. This whole universe is categorized in six padarthas. Ayurveda uses the term Karana (cause) for Padartha
AF1443 पद्म पत्र वर्ण padma patra varṇa Color or red lotus petal
AF1444 पद्म वर्ण padma varṇa Lotus color
AF1445 पद्मपत्राभं दृष्टिमण्डल padmapatrābhaṁ dṛṣṭimaṇḍala Pupil with the color of red lotus petal
AF1446 पद्मसन्निभं padmasannibhaṁ Blood with the color of red lotus
SK0137 पाद pāda Lower extremity, foot. One of the Karmendriyas.

SV0181 पाद प्रक्षालन pāda prakṣālana Cleaning & washing feet with water which removes dirt and diseases of feet and fatigue, clarifies vision, promotes semen, wards off evil spirit and gives pleasure.

SV0183 पादंशिक क्रम pādaṁśika krama Unwholesome food practices are to be tapered in quarter / quarter of quarters, and are substituted by Pathyahara (Wholesome food practice) in interval of one, two or three meal time according to condition. Substitution is to be augmented in gradual, phased manner.
SR0264 पादकुर्चास्थीनि pādakurcāsthīni Tarsal bones excluding talus and calcaneus
SR0265 पादतलम् pādatalam Sole. Under part of the foot

SV0184 पादत्र धारण pādatra dhāraṇa Regular wearing of foot wares – alleviates diseases of feet, promotes semen, ward off evil organisms, gives pleasure and comfort in moving and is wholesome for Ojas. prevents from abrasions of thorn, stone, gravels , dust etc.
AF1419 पादनर्तन pādanartana Dancing movement of foot.
BK0111 पादशिष्टं pādaśiṣṭaṁ Reducing to 1/4th portion of decoction
AF1420 पादसदनं pādasadanaṁ Fatigue of leg
SR0261 पादाग्रम् pādāgram Fore-foot. Front of the foot
SV0182 पादाघात pādāghāta Body message with feet.
SR0262 पादांगुलयः pādāṁgulayaḥ Toes. Digits of the foot
SR0263 पादांगुष्ठः pādāṁguṣṭhaḥ Toes. Digits of the foot
AT0237 पादुका पादपीठेषु pādukā pādapīṭheṣu Mode of administration of poison along with shoes or foot cushions.
